title: Quality Inspector (NDT/QMS)
description: Overview & Responsibilities We are seeking a highly meticulous Quality Inspector to join our Supply Chain department. In this critical operational role, you will be the frontline safeguard for the Ebara Elliott Energy's Quality Management System, ensuring the absolute integrity of precision turbomachinery parts and components. Your primary focus will involve rigorous quality checks on critical materials destined for steam turbines, centrifugal compressors, and both multistage and cryogenic pumps. By verifying that all incoming materials, in-process assemblies, and final products meet our stringent engineering standards, you will directly support our commitment to delivering world-class, reliable turbomachinery equipment. Job Responsibilities Interpret Technical Documentation: Read, analyze, and accurately apply complex engineering documentation, including work orders, assembly and manufacturing blueprints, special instructions, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and material specifications specific to turbomachinery. Execute Precision Measurements: Utilize a comprehensive array of manual and digital measuring devices to perform dimensional inspections, ensuring that turbine, compressor, and pump components strictly conform to drawing tolerances, quality standards, and completeness requirements. Conduct NDT Inspections: Perform thorough incoming, in-process, and final Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) inspections across various stages of the supply chain lifecycle to identify surface and subsurface defects. Manage Quality Documentation: Initiate and process critical quality control documentation, including scrap and rework reports, Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs), and comprehensive quality action reports to track and resolve discrepancies. Maintain Equipment Calibration: Oversee the calibration processes and maintain meticulous logs for all inspection and measuring equipment, encompassing both company-issued quality center tools and personally owned precision instruments. Verify Incoming Supply Chain Materials: Inspect, identify, and formally approve incoming raw materials and outsourced components, verifying they match engineering drawings and material specifications before being released to the floor. Execute Operational Priorities: Effectively manage daily workflow by receiving, prioritizing, and adhering to inspection schedules and urgent operational targets set by supply chain management. Escalate Non-Conformances: Proactively identify, thoroughly document, and raise immediate awareness regarding any material or procedural non-conformances to the appropriate engineering and management teams. Uphold Safety and 5S Standards: Strictly adhere to all facility safety protocols and maintain workstations in a clean, organized, and highly functional operating condition. Author Inspection Reports: Draft clear, concise, and highly accurate inspection reports to maintain a permanent, traceable record for all evaluated parts. Validate Supplier Compliance: Review and analyze Material Test Reports (MTRs) provided by external suppliers to guarantee absolute compliance with Elliott's proprietary material specifications. Perform Final Release Inspections: Conduct rigorous final quality inspections on all finished turbomachinery parts and components prior to their approval for shipment or inventory storage. Required Qualifications & Skills: Experience: A minimum of two (2) years of dedicated inspection and quality control experience within an industrial, manufacturing, or supply chain environment. Rotating Equipment & Turbomachinery experience with an OEM is highly preferred. NDT Knowledge: Strong foundational understanding of core Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) methodologies, specifically Penetrant Testing (PT), Ultrasonic Testing (UT), Radiographic Testing (RT), and Magnetic Particle Testing (MT). Advanced Certifications (Preferred): Highly qualified candidates will possess an active ASNT Level 2 certification in Visual Testing (VT) or possess the prerequisite training to obtain it. Equipment Proficiency: Demonstrated hands-on experience utilizing a broad spectrum of specialized NDT equipment and advanced precision measuring tools. Dimensional Tool Mastery: High proficiency in reading and operating manual and digital measuring tools, including micrometers, calipers, dial indicators, height gauges, and related inspection instruments. NDT Hardware Operation: Practical familiarity with operating non-destructive testing hardware, such as magnetic particle yokes/machines, ultrasonic flaw detectors, digital thickness indicators, and ultraviolet (black light) equipment. Technical Comprehension: Exceptional ability to accurately read and interpret complex mechanical scopes of work, detailed blueprints, special engineering procedures, and technical component specifications. Operational Flexibility: Willingness to work overtime and alternating shifts as required to support fluctuating plant operations, production schedules, and supply chain demands. Education: A high school diploma or equivalent is required; candidates with advanced or specialized technical training in quality control, metallurgy, or machining will be given strong preference. Software Skills: Familiarity with the Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook) for report generation, data entry, and internal communication. Customers throughout the world choose Elliott for the design, manufacture and service of their critical rotating equipment. Elliott’s global service network routinely installs, overhauls, repairs, upgrades and rerates machines from any manufacturer. Teradata delivers real business value with AI. What You'll Do As a Staff Software Engineer in the Enterprise Data Protection (EDP) team, you will be a senior technical leader responsible for designing, building, and delivering highly scalable, reliable, and secure cloud-native data protection solutions. This is a deeply hands-on role for an engineer who combines strong architectural and engineering depth, practical AI expertise, and an aggressive delivery mindset . You will be expected not only to solve complex technical problems, but also to drive solutions from ambiguity to production with speed, ownership, and engineering excellence. Your responsibilities will include: Own architecture and technical direction for complex capabilities within the EDP platform, translating product and business requirements into scalable, maintainable, and production-ready solutions. Drive complex initiatives end-to-end , from technical exploration and architecture through implementation, testing, rollout, operationalisation, and production stabilisation. Design and build highly available, resilient, and scalable distributed systems and microservices using Java and modern cloud-native technologies . Provide technical leadership for EDP capabilities spanning AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), hybrid, and on-premises environments . Apply strong distributed-systems fundamentals to challenges involving data protection, backup and restore, large-scale data movement, orchestration, resiliency, security, and failure recovery. Bring practical AI expertise to engineering. Identify opportunities to use AI, generative AI, agents, and AI-assisted development to accelerate software engineering, improve product capabilities, automate operational workflows, and increase developer productivity. Rapidly prototype and validate AI-driven solutions, and convert successful experiments into secure, reliable, production-quality capabilities. Promote effective use of AI-assisted software development across design, implementation, code review, testing, debugging, documentation, and troubleshooting while maintaining appropriate engineering judgement and quality controls. Demonstrate an aggressive delivery mindset by breaking large problems into incremental outcomes, removing technical blockers, making pragmatic decisions, and maintaining strong execution momentum without compromising critical quality, security, or reliability requirements. Make thoughtful technical trade-offs between speed, scalability, reliability, maintainability, operational complexity, and business impact. Establish and raise engineering standards around architecture, coding, APIs, observability, testing, security, performance, deployment, and operational readiness. Lead technical design and code reviews and actively contribute production-quality code for critical components. Diagnose complex production and distributed-system issues across application, infrastructure, database, networking, and cloud layers. Identify architectural and technical debt proactively and drive improvements that simplify the platform and increase engineering velocity. Collaborate closely with architects, product managers, engineering managers, QA engineers, SRE/DevOps teams, and other engineering organisations to deliver business-critical capabilities. Mentor and technically influence engineers across the team , helping raise the overall engineering bar without requiring formal management authority. Take ownership beyond individual features by identifying gaps, challenging assumptions, proposing solutions, and driving them to measurable outcomes.
